robustness.values_above_come_from_retain: Values above come from retained, checksummed Modal output staging. “Open current JSON” opens today''s sandbox file, which may have changed. robustness.new_work_must_be_reviewed_aga: . New work must be reviewed against this revision; existing workflows retain their original plan.
robustness.spec_contains_metric_unit_nul: . Spec contains metric, unit, nullValue, seed and parameters. Honor the seed in every library used. Write JSON with schemaVersion=1, matching metric/unit, estimate, qc=pass|warn|fail (omit estimate if QC failed and it cannot be computed), optionally interval '{'low,high,level'}', sampleSize and notes. No code runs locally during preview.
